intuition: After sorting, fixing one value turns the remaining search into a two-sum scan over the suffix.

brute_force.approach: Try every triple, keep triples summing to zero, and deduplicate the results.

optimal.approach: Sort once, then use two pointers for each first value. Skip repeated first, left, and right values so each value-triplet is emitted once.

edge_cases: Fewer than three values cannot form a triplet.
Skip duplicate values after recording a match to avoid repeated triplets.
Break when the fixed value is positive because the sorted suffix cannot bring the sum back to zero.
